data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017, net ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) reduced by GBP 10.1m. This was mainly due to favourable claims experience in Director and Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo resulting in reserve releases in line with standard actuarial techniques. This was offset by net ultimate claims increases in International Construction (adverse attritional and large loss development on Starr coverholder business), Professional Indemnity (large losses reported in the year; Appleyby, Shepherd Building Group, Precision and Pitcher Partners) and General Liability (adverse attritional development).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 experienced an overall gross reserve release of GBP 6.661 million for prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) in 2017. This was primarily driven by favourable claims development in Director and Officers, Marine Liability, and Marine Cargo. However, these releases were partially offset by adverse claims development and large losses in International Construction, Professional Indemnity (including specific cases like Appleyby, Shepherd Building Group, Precision and Pitcher Partners), and General Liability.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -6.661m is calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 40. The narrative on page 41 explicitly states a 'net ultimate claims reduction of GBP 10.1m' for prior underwriting years, which differs from the gross figure derived from the triangle. The gross premium mix uses the regulatory segmental analysis from page 28, as a divisional breakdown with corresponding premium amounts was not available in the report.
